hero.badge: CLI-first · Team dashboard · No code uploaded
hero.headline: See how your team uses AI coding tools
hero.subhead: DevPulse turns local AI coding sessions into team-level usage insights, cost visibility, and daily work summaries.
hero.flow: Account first → create or join a team → then connect the CLI on your machine.

how.title: From sign-up to team visibility in four steps
how.step1Body: Create an account, then create a new team or join with an invite code.
how.step2Body: Install the CLI and run login — your browser opens to authorize this computer.
how.step3Body: See connected machines and revoke access anytime under Settings.
how.step4Body: Scan local AI tool logs and upload metadata — run again anytime.

features.title: A team dashboard built from local session metadata
features.toolsBody: See which coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, OpenClaw) and models each session used.
features.tokensBody: Track token usage, session counts, active time, and trends over time — by team or member.
features.memberBody: Per-person views: who was active, what they worked on, and how agents split their day.
features.summariesBody: AI-generated recaps for each member and the whole team — focused on what shipped, not token counts.
features.historyBody: Browse synced sessions with project, agent, model, and a short summary per session.
features.privacyBody: Only derived metadata and summaries are uploaded — never full transcripts, prompts, or code.

cta.title: Ready to make AI work visible?
cta.bodyUser: Run devpulse login on your machine to connect, then devpulse sync to upload sessions.
cta.bodyGuest: Start with a free account. The CLI connects after your team is set up.

footer.tagline: Lightweight AI work intelligence for small teams
